Pkg.0001.description:
Project references a package included in this upgrade.

The project references one of the packages being upgraded. This finding records the reference (current and proposed version) so the assessment lists every affected project even when no breaking API changes were detected.
Pkg.0001.label: Project references an upgraded package

Pkg.0003.description:
NuGet package version diverges across the scoped projects.

Different projects need or support different versions of the package, so a single unified upgrade version could not be selected. Review the per-project breakdown and decide whether to align the projects on a common version or upgrade them independently.
Pkg.0003.label: NuGet package version diverges across projects
